what_ready_means_here: READY = operationally defensible owner-facing research valuation tool, exactly as the contract defines it. It does not mean peer-reviewed truth, historically proven alpha, or permission to publish.

QQQ.note: NDX-ratio indicative equivalent, not a reconstructed ETF NAV fair value

canonical_terminal.equations: RI4 = (LTROE - Ke) * B3 ; CV3 = RI4 / (Ke - g_base) ; stable_retention = g_base / LTROE
canonical_terminal.g_macro_source: FOMC June 2026 SEP Table 1 longer-run medians: real GDP 2.0%, PCE inflation 2.0%; (1.02 * 1.02) - 1

sensitivity_100bp.note: g_high is clamped by the Rf cap and sits 65bp above g_base, not 100bp. The cap doing its job, not a widened gate.

disclosures.meaning: NDX's g_low..g_high envelope spans its current price, so the model does not take a directional position on NDX at this reading. Per the frozen criteria this is a disclosure, not a failure. The old E5 F2 gate would have called this a failure by a sign test at exactly zero; that test was discontinuous and is not the stability metric here.

reverse_implied.reading: NDX is priced almost exactly at the model's own assumptions. SPX requires 4.69pp more long-run ROE, or 1.04pp less equity risk premium, than the model assumes. The numbers are interpretable without any calibration to spot, which is the R13 evidence.

R1_canonical_ssot_and_parity.evidence: feno-index-rim-canonical-criteria.json committed at 79717ab76f before any result existed; scripts/build-rim-index-final.mjs reads every parameter from it; scripts/test-build-rim-index-final.mjs asserts the runtime restates no economic literal and that the criteria hash matches its freeze receipt; 11 checks pass

R2_operands_source_clock_valid.evidence: source_clock_failures empty; LTROE recomputed from benchmark rows matches the frozen bases to 1e-9; Rf asserted equal to the frozen 2026-08-06 DGS10 reading; Damodaran ERP asserted equal to the frozen base and its source_date to 2026-04-01

R3_append_only_archives.evidence: three lanes at data/computed/rim-index/archive/ (forecast, payout, erp) via scripts/archive-rim-inputs.mjs; scripts/test-archive-rim-inputs.mjs 4/4 pass on independent handler re-run, including vintage 1 surviving a deduped refresh and both vintages surviving a genuinely new observation

R4_no_price_used_to_choose_parameters.evidence: freeze receipt asserts all eight result paths and both implementation files were verified absent when the criteria were written; g from the SEP, ERP from the live Damodaran reading, LTROE from the 10-year ROE median rule

R5_g_from_frozen_macro_rule.evidence: g_base 4.04% from the SEP longer-run medians read out of the released PDF, not the old g = Rf = 4.63% cap-as-central-estimate; the cap at 4.69% does not bind

R6_stable_retention_valid.evidence: SPX 0.1797 to 0.1881, NDX 0.1290 to 0.1333, every cell inside [0, 1]

R7_pole_margin.evidence: min Ke - g = 5.18pp for both indices against a 3.00pp gate

R8_terminal_share.evidence: Base terminal share SPX 65.7% and NDX 77.6% against 90%; worst cell 69.4% and 80.0%

R9_terminal_sensitivity.evidence: max absolute Base move under the 100bp shadows: SPX 9.83%, NDX 11.62%, against 20%

R10_monotonicity.evidence: full 3x3 monotone in both axes for both indices, and BULL >= BASE >= BEAR

R11_payout_materiality.evidence: route A vs B Base shift SPX 0.0035% and NDX 0.907%, grid-mean shift 0.0035% and 0.909%, against 5%; both grids monotone

R12_independent_reproduction.evidence: three implementations: the node runtime, a handler-owned Python re-derivation (41 quantities, worst relative difference 7.6e-07, zero above 1e-6), and a worker-owned Python implementation that re-derived the operands from source rather than reusing the inputs builder. All 18 grid cells, the scenario levels, terminal share, pole margin, sensitivity and reverse-implied values agree below 1e-6 across all three.

R13_no_target_fitting.evidence: identical formula, grid rule and growth rule for both indices; no per-index multiplier or offset exists in the criteria or the runtime; the outputs land 20.1% below spot on SPX and 0.7% above on NDX, so the model demonstrably does not track price

R14_historical_retire_condition.evidence: conditional on >=5 authentic origins; there are 0 for both indices, so the antecedent is false and the condition cannot fire. It is not claimed as passed on evidence.

historical_validation.reason: authentic live-semantic vintages did not exist before append-only archival began
historical_validation.why_this_is_structural_not_a_search_fail: The repository was created 2025-06-28, two days before the last origin in the 2019-06-30..2025-06-30 window. The FY1/FY2/FY3 consensus source first appeared 2026-06-12 and the index yield observations behind both payout routes first appeared 2026-01-10, twelve and six months after the last origin. No origin in the window can have a repo-committed vintage of those legs. Verified against the origin repository through the read-only GitHub API, because the local checkout is a shallow clone truncated at 2026-06-29 and would have understated the history.
historical_validation.benchmark_rows_are_retrospective: data/benchmarks/us.json arrived on 2025-12-13 already carrying 861 rows back to 2010-01-01. Dated rows inside a file first published later are backfill, not point-in-time vintages.
historical_validation.erp_leg_recovered_but_insufficient: The Damodaran ctryprem country-premium archive exists locally with per-file sha256 receipts and its as-of dates are now adjudicated (ctrypremYY is the January YY+1 update; six files form an unbroken annual chain under the datemode=1 reading). That makes the ERP leg recoverable at annual granularity from January 2018. One recovered leg of three cannot make an origin whole.
historical_validation.e6_verdict_preserved: FENO_INDEX_RIM_RESEARCH_ONLY remains the truthful historical-validation verdict under its own frozen criteria, unrevised. This decision answers the different question the contract posed: whether the live product is operationally defensible now.

yoo_equation.position: unchanged and not hunted further. The product is a Yoo-style top-down scenario RIM successor. It is never to be described as reproducing Yoo's exact arithmetic.

defects_found_and_repaired_in_this_pass: The committed runtime and the committed E5 script implemented different terminals, disagreeing by about 48% on the SPX headline number. Resolved by making one file the authority and making the runtime read it. This is the finding that most justified the pass.

The implied-ERP solver kept pre-stable-growth bounds whose lower end sat inside the ke > g pole and returned an undefined value. Bound replaced with a 50bp pole margin. No READY gate reads this solver.

The handler's own first reading of git history came from a shallow checkout and understated first-appearance dates by six to twelve months. The worker's dates were correct; the origin API confirmed the worker.

what_ready_does_not_authorize.public_promotion: PUBLIC_ROWS stays empty, display_ready stays false, the RIM public surface stays quarantined. Promotion needs a separate owner approval.
what_ready_does_not_authorize.historical_claims: The tool is not historically validated and must not be described as such.

known_limits_carried_forward: The Damodaran ERP at 2026-04-01 is the oldest binding input and is disclosed beside every number.
NDX carries FAIR_VALUE_OVERLAP at this reading: its terminal-sensitivity envelope spans the current price, so the model is not taking a direction on NDX today.
The terminal still carries 66% of SPX value and 78% of NDX value. Inside the frozen gate, but it is the largest single lever in the model.
Historical validation becomes possible only prospectively, as the append-only archive accumulates vintages from 2026-08-08 forward.
